section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the aims and hypotheses of a single study examining associations between nature exposure, connectedness to nature, and body appreciation in community adults in the U.S. The study plans to use the BAS-2 (rather than the BAS) to measure body appreciation and will employ path analysis to test direct and indirect (mediated by self-esteem) relationships, as well as broader body image variables including investment in appearance and internalization of appearance ideals. The analysis will be conducted separately for women and men to examine potential sex-specific effects.
